title: Gemini Function-Calling Surface — V3
description: Exhaustive enumeration of tools Gemini may invoke during a search session. All tool calls are executed by the Cloud Run server — Gemini never touches WooCommerce APIs, the database, or the cart directly. No free SQL, no price mutation, no cart changes without user confirmation. Source authority: SPEC-V3-FULL.md §12.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search the product catalog by keywords and structured filters. Returns raw product records for Gemini to rank and evaluate. Never invent product IDs — use only IDs this tool returns.

keywords.description: Plain-text search terms derived from the interpreted intent. These are the words the index searches — Gemini must derive them, not pass the raw user string.

category_ids.description: Only use category_ids returned by list_categories — never invent.

dietary.description: Dietary constraints e.g. kosher, vegan, gluten-free. Advisory — server maps to real attribute filters.

limit.description: Number of results. Server caps at 48 regardless.

server_validation: limit capped at 48
category_ids verified against tenant taxonomy — unknown IDs return empty set, not error
unknown filter keys stripped before execution
empty keywords array returns top-selling products (not an error)

tools.name: get_product_details
tools.description: Get full structured details of a specific product — ingredients, allergens, weight, variants. Use only product IDs previously returned by search_products. Never invent IDs.

product_id.description: WooCommerce product ID. Must have been returned by search_products in this session.

server_validation: product_id must exist in tenant's catalog
invisible/draft/deleted products return 404 — model must handle gracefully
model may not call get_product_details on IDs it invented
inferred allergen and origin fields carry review_required: true — never present as confirmed

tools.name: get_live_product_state
tools.description: Get the real-time price and stock status of a product from WooCommerce. Use when you need to verify current price or stock before recommending the product, especially after get_product_details showed stale cache data.

product_id.description: WooCommerce product ID. Must have been returned by search_products.

server_validation: calls WooCommerce REST API — not a cache hit
product_id must exist in tenant's catalog
result is never cached (always live)

tools.name: find_substitutes
tools.description: Find substitute products for a product that is out of stock, too expensive, or not preferred by the user. Returns substitute products with a brief explanation of the difference.

product_id.description: The product to find substitutes for. Must have been returned by search_products.

reason.description: Why the user wants a substitute. Guides the similarity search.

server_validation: product_id must exist in tenant catalog
results come from the precomputed substitute graph — never invented
allergen safety substitutions must carry review_required: true
complementary products must NOT appear in substitute results

tools.name: find_complementary_products
tools.description: Find products that complement a given product (e.g. cheese to accompany a wine, sauce for pasta). Do not use for substitutes.

product_id.description: The product to find complements for. Must have been returned by search_products.

context.description: Optional context for the complement search e.g. 'hosting', 'weekday dinner'.

server_validation: product_id must exist in tenant catalog
results from precomputed complement graph — never invented
substitutes must NOT appear in complementary results

tools.name: get_active_promotions
tools.description: Get currently active promotions — sale events, bundle discounts, coupon campaigns. Use this to surface relevant deals after establishing product relevance. Never surface promotions before confirming the product is relevant.

product_ids.description: If provided, return only promotions applicable to these products. Must be IDs from search_products.

label.description: Short human-readable label e.g. '20% off chicken this week'

server_validation: result scoped to tenant_id only
expired promotions are never returned
prices in promotions are informational — final price comes from WooCommerce Store API at checkout

tools.name: compose_shopping_bundle
tools.description: Group a set of products into a coherent shopping bundle for a stated occasion or meal plan. Returns a structured bundle the UI can render as a 'complete the basket' suggestion.

product_ids.description: Product IDs to include. Must be IDs from search_products.

occasion.description: The occasion or meal context e.g. 'shabbat dinner', 'cheese board for 4'.

server_validation: all product_ids must have been returned by search_products in this session
suggest_qty is advisory — never passed to cart without user confirmation
estimated_total is informational — final price from WooCommerce at checkout

tools.name: search_store_knowledge
tools.description: Search the store's knowledge base — FAQs, product policies, delivery information, kashrut certificates, allergen guides. Use for informational requests that do not require a product search.

query.description: Natural-language search query against the knowledge base.

topic.description: Optional topic hint to narrow the search.

url.description: Store-relative URL — never invented, always from knowledge base index

server_validation: URLs are served from the tenant's own knowledge index — no external URLs
result is never fabricated — only stored knowledge is returned
empty result is a valid response (not an error)

tools.name: request_navigation
tools.description: Signal that the user should be navigated to a specific store section or category page. This does NOT navigate the user — it returns a navigation instruction the browser UI executes.

category_id.description: Required when destination_type is 'category'. Must be a valid category_id from list_categories.

product_id.description: Required when destination_type is 'product'. Must be from search_products.

label.description: Human-readable label for the navigation action e.g. 'View all cheeses'.

server_validation: category_id verified against tenant taxonomy — invalid ID returns error
product_id verified against tenant catalog
destination URL constructed server-side — model never constructs URLs

tools.name: request_cart_action
tools.description: Prepare a structured cart-add instruction for the browser to execute — after user confirmation. The model never adds to the cart directly. This tool returns a pending action that the browser presents as 'Add to basket?' and executes only on explicit user approval.

product_id.description: WooCommerce product ID. Must have been returned by search_products in this session.

quantity.description: Quantity to add. Advisory — user adjusts before confirming.

variation_id.description: Required for variable products. Must come from get_product_details.

reason.description: Short human-readable reason why the model recommends this addition e.g. 'best match for your occasion'. Shown to user alongside the confirmation prompt. ≤80 chars.

pending_action_id.description: Opaque ID the browser uses to identify the pending action.

server_validation: product_id must exist in tenant's catalog
variation_id validated against product variants if provided
confirmation_required is always true — model must never bypass this
browser executes POST /wp-json/wc/store/v1/cart/add-item only after user confirms
this tool PREPARES the action — it does not execute it

tools.name: decompose_recipe
tools.description: Decompose a dish or meal name into ingredient search keywords. Returns keyword strings only — not prices, stock, or availability. Never assert allergen or origin status.

dish_name.description: Name of the dish or meal to decompose, in any supported language.

servings.description: Number of servings — used to suggest quantities, not to change which ingredients are returned.

server_validation: result feeds into search_products keywords — it is a string array, not a product list
allergen and origin must NOT be asserted in this response
result is cached by dish_name + locale for 24h

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Return the tenant's available product categories. Use this to discover valid category_ids before calling search_products with category filters. Never invent category IDs.

parent_id.description: If provided, return only categories under this parent. null returns top-level categories.

server_validation: result is scoped to tenant_id — no cross-tenant data
returns id, name, slug, count — no pricing or inventory
result is cached per tenant for 10 min

server_orchestration.description: These are operations the Cloud Run server performs on Gemini's behalf — NOT tools Gemini calls. They are listed here for completeness. Any code that exposes them as Gemini-callable tools is a critical defect.

operations.name: interpret_user_intent
operations.description: Server calls Gemini with the user's raw input and system prompt to produce an IntentResult. This IS Gemini's core reasoning step — not a tool it calls on itself.

operations.name: build_search_plan
operations.description: Server constructs a SearchPlan from the IntentResult and sends it to the retrieval layer. Internal artifact — never sent to the browser or to Gemini as a tool response.

prohibited_tools.description: The following must NEVER appear in the function-calling surface. Any code review finding one of these in Gemini's available tools must be treated as a critical security defect.

entries.name: add_to_cart
entries.reason: Commerce is WC Store API domain — model must not trigger cart changes directly. Use request_cart_action (which requires user confirmation) instead.

entries.name: update_price
entries.reason: Price is set by WooCommerce; AI has no write access

entries.name: get_user_data
entries.reason: PII; model has no user identity context

entries.name: modify_product
entries.reason: Catalog is WC-owned; AI is read-only
